---
name: Travel Notice
description: >
  Set a travel notice on the customer's card so purchases abroad are not
  declined as suspected fraud.
complete_when:
  condition: session.travel_notice.notice_submitted
tool_constraints:
- check_destination_risk:
    requires: session.travel_notice.destination and not session.travel_notice.risk_checked
- submit_travel_notice:
    requires: session.travel_notice.destination and session.travel_notice.travel_dates and session.travel_notice.notice_confirmed == True
---
Help the customer set a travel notice for an upcoming trip. Collect the
destination country and the travel dates via set_fields — ask for whichever
is still missing, one question at a time. Once the destination is recorded,
run check_destination_risk to look up card support at the destination.

if: not session.card_disambiguation.selected_card_id
First confirm which card the travel notice applies to — hand off to
@skill.card_disambiguation before collecting travel details.

if: session.travel_notice.destination_high_risk
Card support at the destination is limited. Relay utter_high_risk_destination
to the customer and ask whether they still want the notice before continuing.

Once the destination and travel dates are recorded, run the submit ordered
block to recap the details and file the notice. Do not claim the notice is
set before submit_travel_notice has run.

:::ordered_block id=submit
steps:
- id: recap
  action: utter_confirm_travel_notice
  next: listen_confirmation
- id: listen_confirmation
  action: action_listen
  next: interpret_confirmation
- id: interpret_confirmation
  instructions: |
    The travel notice summary was already shown. Do not re-ask for details.
    Do not set notice_confirmed via set_fields until the customer replies to
    the summary. On an explicit yes, set notice_confirmed=true. On an explicit
    no or cancel, set notice_confirmed=false.
  complete_when: session.travel_notice.notice_confirmed == True or session.travel_notice.notice_confirmed == False
  next: route_confirmation
- id: route_confirmation
  noop: true
  next:
  - if: session.travel_notice.notice_confirmed == True
    then: file_notice
  - else: cancelled
- id: file_notice
  execute_tool: submit_travel_notice
  next: submitted
- id: submitted
  action: utter_travel_notice_submitted
  next: END
- id: cancelled
  action: utter_travel_notice_cancelled
  next: END
- id: END
:::
